== Summary ==
Only surviving copy (thumbnail, 50×38). Decipher's caption: "DecipherCon guests crowd around Star Trek celebs Chase Masterson and [[Aron Eisenberg]]." Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
